title: Autoscaler deferred-commitment causing tenant SLA backpressure — mitigation & runbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Summary: Several high-importance tenants reported sustained latency / 429s during regional traffic spikes on dedicated capacity. Investigation shows the autoscaler sometimes defers commit of new reserved allocation due to bake-window heuristics + leader throttle, causing a 2-8 minute headroom gap. During that gap tenant requests are routed to cold pools or rejected once burst allowances are exhausted. This ticket owns an immediate mitigation, corrective bugfix, and a short runbook for on-call engineers and SRE to use during an active escalation.
reproduction_steps: 1) Replay production traffic profile for Tenant X with 3x short-lived microbursts separated by <60s idle. 2) Observe autoscaler commit pipeline: scale-prep -> lease-assign -> commit. 3) Inject leadership throttle/raft delay at commit stage (simulated via test harness) and watch reserved allocation stay pending while burst credit drains. 4) Confirm 429s/route fallback and increased P99 latency in dedicated-frontend metrics.
telemetry_and_artifacts: Dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/dedicated_headroom?orgId=1&var-region=us-west1. Incident log: https://ops.redwood/incidents/2026-03-09-dedicated-spike. Heap of traces: https://tracing.redwood/trace?span=autoscaler-commit. Repro harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/autoscale-replay PRs and fixes listed below.
root_cause_analysis: - Root cause: commit path for reserved pool allocations includes a scaled 'bake' safety delay and a leadership path that occasionally stalls under control-plane load. The autoscaler marks allocations as 'pending_commit' and does not advertise headroom to routing until commit completes, while burst budget accounting continues to decrement. - Contributing factors: (a) short safety window tuned too conservatively for multi-tenant microbursts; (b) lease-assign retries interact poorly with leader backpressure; (c) routing logic lacks a soft headroom hint for pending allocations.
decision_and_tradeoffs: Short-term mitigation vs longer-term solution considered: 1) Short-term: advertise provisional headroom from pending_commit to routing with strict expiry (risk: small overcommit if commit fails); 2) Long-term: rework commit state machine to separate 'advertise' from 'durable commit' (safer but 2-3 weeks). We chose short-term provisional advertise to restore customer SLA quickly, followed by durable state-machine change.
mitigation_plan: 1) Emergency patch: provisionally advertise pending reserved capacity to routing with TTL 90s and mark requests as 'provisionally routed' so we can track fallout. 2) Adjust bake-window heuristic from 60s -> 15s for tenants with microburst profiles (config flag). 3) Add telemetry to track provisional advert acceptance and failed commit rollbacks. 4) Communication: notify impacted tenants with summary and ETA for durable fix.

rollback_plan: If provisional-advertise causes overcommit or incorrect routing, revert to previous behavior and immediately enable emergency fallback to model-variant routing (cheaper model with fewer GPU slots) and enable stricter admission control for microsurge profiles. Reversion steps are automated in runbook and tested in staging.

No overcommit observed in 2-hour canary window. Rollout to remaining AZs in us-west planned 2026-03-14 with monitoring gates.
postmortem_actions_and_followups: - Complete ENG-205317 state-machine refactor before end of Cycle 2026-W13. - Add automatic detection: when commit delays > 30s and burst drain > 40%, auto-enable provisional-advertise for affected tenants. - Publish a dedicated runbook entry and add a paged play for headroom-gap with explicit triage checklist. - Retro with Support and AM to review tenant communications and SLAs.
notes_for_oncall: 1) If alerted for HeadroomGap page, run 'alloc-inspect --tenant <id>' and check pending_commit queue length. 2) If pending_commit > 10 and burst_budget draining, enable provisional-advertise via feature-flag 'provisional_advertise=on' scoped to tenant/az and observe telemetry for 10m. 3) If errors spike after provisional advertise, revert flag and follow rollback_plan. 4) Escalate to @MiguelTorres and @PriyaSuresh immediately for cross-team coordination.
final_comments: This ticket is a bridging ticket: short-term provisional advertise restores SLAs quickly while the state-machine refactor will remove the class of defect. We will schedule an external-facing postmortem summary after the durable fix. Please add any evidence or customer feedback to this ticket.
